defaultDisposition: Inactive: registered application routes retain their existing behavior. Active: only reviewed enabledProtectedRoutes and exact dedicated boundaries proceed; every other protected request is denied before authentication or business queries.

activation.gateRule: Activation is prohibited until enabledProtectedRoutes is nonempty and every supported route omitted from it already has a frozen-product-prohibited disposition. Gate 1 pre-RLS regression runs with this control inactive.

unknownDedicatedBoundaryDisposition: While inactive, unknown routes reach the existing generic 404 handler. While active, unknown protected and telemetry descendants are denied; unknown paths beneath the non-overlapping public/auth/customer/health prefixes reach the generic 404 handler.
exemptDedicatedBoundaries: health and readiness without protected business reads
exemptionRule: An exempt router is not database-authorized by the exemption; its exact boundary must be certified before RLS activation.
operatorDisposition: Operator-only routes remain disabled unless separately registered behind an exact operator procedure.

denialControl.order: The shared pre-auth denial limiter increments before any shutdown warning is emitted.
denialControl.networkKey: Normalized client IP hashed with the application's versioned IP HMAC secret into a fixed privacy-preserving bucket; body, query, resource path, bearer token, user agent and caller identity are excluded.
denialControl.overLimitDisposition: 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After; the request remains denied before authentication or business access.
denialControl.sharedStore: The existing Redis rate-limit store provides horizontal-instance coordination whenever Redis is configured.
denialControl.sharedStoreFailure: A monotonic per-instance memory counter is incremented on every request and becomes the conservative limiter if Redis is unavailable; Redis failure never allows the request to reach a protected workflow.
denialControl.logging: At most the configured number of per-denial warnings plus one suppression summary are emitted for one network bucket in one window. Generic per-request completion logging is suppressed for shutdown denials so it cannot create a second unbounded stream; aggregate request metrics are still recorded against the fixed unresolved-route label.

auditEvent.payloadProhibition: No concrete path, raw request ID, request body, query values, resource identifiers, IP address, credentials, bearer token, user agent or protected row data.
auditEvent.durabilityRequirement: Production activation requires the existing structured log sink to retain this event immutably.
